method: video.crossOrigin=anonymous reload of the timing media_url in the in-app browser, seek to the timing decision frame, canvas drawImage -> JPEG (1280x720); the SNY bug region (x 55-310, y 25-135) enlarged 3x and read by eye. Bug rows: NYM (top) = away, ATL (bottom) = home; filled circles = outs; diamond fill = runners; arrow = top/bottom.
